nate: Heads up — small surge of 503s from embeddings-service after the batching tweak. I queued a hotpatch candidate (2.3.2). Need fast approvals for a 08:00-08:45 PST window. Short rollback ready.

deploy-bot: @channel Hotpatch ready: embeddings-service:2.3.2
  - root cause: KV cache overflow on tiny-batch path after batching optimization
  - plan: canary 2% us-west1 for 10m -> 20% for 10m -> 100%
  - gating: requires 2 eng approvals + oncall ack
  Approve with "+1" or :thumbsup:. Pin: `rdwctl pin embeddings-service 2.3.2`

carla: Can someone paste rollback command + registry digest? Ops wants artifact pinned in case we roll back.

zane: Rollback: `rdwctl rollback --service=embeddings-service --to=2.3.1 --force`
  Artifact: registry.redwood/embeddings-service@sha256:3f7a9c... (pinned)

release-qa: Quick canary smoke ready. We'll run the small-batch regression suite on the canary at 2m and 8m.

prod-oncall: I can be on pager for the window. +1 provisional; confirm once canary shows 503 drop. Set trace tag `hotpatch=1718504321` so we can filter.
nate: I'll pin the artifact once we have two engineering + oncall.

carla: +1 from me. Docs-bot: will you draft a 1-line release blurb?
docs-bot: Draft saved: "embeddings-service v2.3.2: fix KV cache overflow causing intermittent 503s on small batches." Will publish on deploy start if you confirm.

zane: +1. Oncall ack confirmed.

deploy-bot: Canary steady at 9m. Ramping to 20% per plan.
